title: Study to Assess the Injection Burden, Safety, Efficacy, and Long-Term Preservation of Visual Acuity of Surabgene Lomparvovec (ABBV-RGX-314) Compared to Ranibizumab in Adult Participants with Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration (nAMD)
official: A Randomized, Controlled, Partially Masked, Phase 3b Study to Assess the Injection Burden, Efficacy, Safety, and Long-Term Preservation of Visual Acuity of Surabgene Lomparvovec (ABBV-RGX-314) in a Real-World Context in Subjects with Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration (nAMD)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate anti-VEGF injection burden and long-term efficacy after subretinal surabgene lomparvovec administration, both within a clinical trial setting (first year of the study) and under simulated real-world conditions (from Year 2 to Year 5), compared to PRN intravitreal ranibizumab given per protocol specified criteria during Year 1, and subsequently compared to a PRN intravitreal ranibizumab schedule that reflects the real-world clinic setting after (Year 2 to Year 5).

interventions.name: Lucentis 10 mg/ml solution for injection in pre-filled syringe

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Pseudophakic (at least 12 weeks post cataract surgery at Screening Visit 1 [Week –6]) in the study eye
2. Must have a diagnosis of CNV secondary to AMD in the study eye
3. Must have received at least 2 intravitreal anti-VEGF injections in the past 6 months in the study eye prior to Screening Visit 1 (Week –6) and have been responsive (determined by investigator)
Exclusion criteria:
1. CNV or macular edema in the study eye that is secondary to any causes other than AMD.
2. Study eye with nAMD diagnosed > 4 years from Screening Visit 1
3. Any subretinal hemorrhage in the study eye > 50% of the total lesion area or within the parafovea (3 mm center of the macula), as determined by the central reading center.
4. History of retinal detachment, retinal tear or macular hole in the study eye that, in the opinion of the investigator, may preclude successful subretinal injection of surabgene lomparvovec.
